title: SvgUse
responsibility: Renders the native use element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgUse.children
inputs.description: Optional Svelte Snippet rendered as the child content of the native use element; when it is omitted, the use element renders no child content. The component invokes it as children() with no arguments and adds no wrapper around its output.

outputs.name: SvgUse
outputs.description: The native use element in the SVG namespace, with every prop other than children applied to it as an attribute and the children snippet rendered inside it when provided. The component adds no wrapper element around it.
